chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Ibn Bukayr, from ʿAbd al-Hamid al-Ta'i, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

I heard him saying: When the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم had performed the later night prayer, he would retire to his bed and would not perform any of the supererogatory prayers except after the middle of the night, neither in the month of Ramadan nor in other than it.

key_terms.النَّوَافِلِ: supererogatory prayers performed in addition to the obligatory prayers
key_terms.الْعِشَاءَ الْآخِرَةَ: the later night prayer, meaning salat al-ʿisha'

ai.seo_question: When did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم perform the night nawafil after salat al-ʿisha'?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding the night supererogatory prayers. It indicates that after salat al-ʿisha', he would not perform nawafil until after midnight, and that this practice applied both in Ramadan and outside Ramadan.
